title: Consciousness is a biological force with causal powers of its own

statements.text: Consciousness is not an epiphenomenon of brain processes nor merely the subjective perspective on the organism. It realizes a biological force with causal powers of its own, and the causal contribution of affective qualia is to prioritize needs in context.

sources.quote: consciousness realizes a biological force with definite causal powers of its own
this is the causal contribution of qualia
